Proposes an approach (Squeez: LoRA-fine-tuned Qwen 3.5 2B that prunes a single tool output to the minimal verbatim evidence for a query); secondary: proposes an evaluation method (benchmark of 11,477 examples, 618-example curated test set)
Squeez-2B (Qwen 3.5 2B + LoRA; no version). Compared with zero-shot Qwen 3.5 35B A3B, Kimi K2, Qwen 3.5 2B base, and heuristics BM25, First-N, Last-N, Random (each keeping ~10% of lines)
None of the SDD kind. Input: focused extraction query + one raw tool observation; output: verbatim relevant lines wrapped in <relevant lines> tags (gold: line spans). Not specifications

Not a development flow. Pruning step inserted between a tool call and the agent's next reasoning step (vLLM-served model or CLI filter on piped output). Dataset pipeline: collect tool outputs, teacher LLM writes query and selects spans, manual curation of test set, LoRA fine-tuning
None in the pruning flow; manual curation of the held-out test set (111 of 729 candidates excluded)
Single component evaluated offline on single tool observations; no coding agent or full trajectory run

Held-out 618-example test set (split by repository / tool family). Configurations: Squeez-2B vs 3 zero-shot LLMs and 4 heuristics. Baseline: Qwen 3.5 2B base and heuristics. Held constant: same <query>/<tool output> prompt for all generative models; heuristics at ~10% of lines. Acceptance: gold spans. Repetitions: not stated (single run). Human intervention: N/A

Squeez-2B best on precision, recall and F1: recall +11 pts vs Qwen 3.5 35B A3B (0.86 vs 0.75) and +33 vs 2B base, at the same 92% compression; heuristics far lower (BM25 recall 0.22). Negatives: 80% vs 7% (Qwen 35B) correct empty output. No significance test

Distinguished all systems clearly. Repeatability: single run, no variance reported. Limitations stated: single observations not trajectories; span overlap misses valid alternative prunings; grep and lint labels noisier
No downstream end-to-end task-completion evaluation; usefulness approximated by span overlap; noisier tool families (grep, lint); residual errors are adjacent over-selection
